acceptance_criterion: A raid creates a persistent top-right card; clicking it pans the camera to the bandits.

implementation.bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] spawns one persistent ~AlertStackUI GameObject (DontDestroyOnLoad), separate object from EventLogUI. Idempotent (FindExisting guard).
implementation.canvas: Self-built ScreenSpaceOverlay Canvas sortingOrder=200, top-right anchored/pivoted column root, edgeMargin inset.
implementation.panel_style: Uses UITheme.MakeBorderedPanel (shared warm dark-brown fill + Divider border) + UITheme.LoadKoreanFont -> matches every other panel.
implementation.subscription: READ-ONLY director.OnEventFired += HandleEvent. Lesson #7 firewall: director is poll-found in Update (EnsureDirector), NOT blind-subscribed in OnEnable; re-finds if null. Unsub in OnDestroy.
implementation.filter: threatTier >= 1 only (raid/wolf_pack/mental-break/siege/infestation/large_raid). Tier 0 ambient stays in EventLog only.
implementation.card: Persistent clickable card: bordered panel + left tier-color accent bar + bold tier-tinted title. Full-card transparent raycast hit area (IPointerClickHandler). Tier1=AccentOrange (amber), tier2=lerp, tier3=TextDanger (DANGER_RED).
implementation.expiry: Auto-expire ~30s (cardLifetimeSec) via Time.unscaledTime delta in Update, OR on click. maxCards=6 cap evicts oldest.
implementation.camera_pan: Click -> BeginPanToThreat -> MoveTowards (fixed units/sec, batchmode-deterministic, mirrors CameraController.RequestFocus). Camera.main null-safe.
implementation.allocations: No per-frame List allocation; cards list reused, FindObjectsByType used only on click/relayout not every frame for bandits.

bug_pattern_firewall.#7_singleton_subscription_race: AVOIDED — poll-find director via Update, not OnEnable blind subscribe.
bug_pattern_firewall.#9_runInBackground_freeze: AVOIDED — expiry + pan use Time.unscaledTime deltas inside Update, NO WaitForSeconds heartbeat coroutine, NO new always-on background timer. AutoScreenshotter retains runInBackground ownership for CLI QA.
bug_pattern_firewall.#4_audio_buzz: N/A — no AudioBank calls from this file.
bug_pattern_firewall.#8_justSpawned_default_true: N/A — spawnTime set to Time.unscaledTime at creation, no default-true grace field.

QA_FLAGS.detail: GameEvent has NO source-position field (id/title/description/flavor/threatTier only) and AIDirector.cs is OUT OF LANE (cannot add one). Pan target is a best-effort heuristic, NOT the exact bandit spawn point. Priority order: (1) nearest live BanditEnemy to colony centroid -> (2) colony centroid of living PawnMovement -> (3) first PawnMovement -> (4) world center (0,0).
QA_FLAGS.acceptance_impact: Satisfies 'pans the camera toward the threat/bandits' for the raid case (live BanditEnemy exists during a raid). For non-spawning threat events (wolf_pack narrative card, mental-break) with no on-map entity, it pans to the colony centroid instead — toward, not at, the source.
QA_FLAGS.followup_if_exact_required: Add a source-position (Vector3) field to GameEvent + populate it in AIDirector.SpawnRaid/FireRandomEvent, then have AlertStackUI cards carry that position. This is a separate wave (touches AIDirector.cs, OP/lane-gated).

QA_FLAGS.detail: NO scene-side SerializeField wiring required. AlertStackUI is fully self-bootstrapping (RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod + self-built Canvas + poll-found AIDirector). No SceneSetup change needed; QA only needs merge-compile + runtime verify.

notes: Compiles against existing public surface: AIDirector.OnEventFired (event Action<GameEvent>), GameEvent.{title,threatTier}, BanditEnemy, PawnMovement, PawnEntity, UITheme.* — all in MelonS.GameProto / .Core. Hand off to QA for merge-compile (alongside Lane A PawnFacing.cs + Lane D AudioBank.PlayMine) and runtime verify of raid->card->click->pan.
